items.title: When does the pattern's upfront cost actually get repaid?
items.description: Models the two cost lines from this unit's own scenarios: the direct if/else version (cost grows slowly per variant, but branches interacting in one function adds a coupling penalty that grows faster as more get piled in) against the Strategy-pattern version (a fixed upfront cost for the interface + factory/registry, then a small, flat cost per added variant). Defaults (2 variants, 0.3 interaction penalty) reproduce Sam's 2-branch shipping calculator, where the direct version is cheaper (2.6 vs. 6) — drag variants up to 5 to reproduce the payment-processing case from L3, where the lines cross and the pattern becomes cheaper (11 vs. 9).

params.name: interactionPenaltyPerPair
params.label: Coupling penalty per pair of branches

items.compute: const n = params.numberOfVariants; const k = params.interactionPenaltyPerPair; return { directCost: n + n * (n - 1) * k, patternCost: 4 + n * 1 };
